questions.question: Who should have come off?
questions.answer: The player who stays down after the check at 1:15 and then skates to the bench.

questions.question: Was the head involved in any contact?
questions.answer: Yes. At 0:40 the contact reaches a player's head. He is back up before the segment ends, so the card is watch.

questions.question: Which hits did they play through?
questions.answer: The board contact at 0:12 and the open-ice bump at 1:40. Both players keep skating.

questions.question: What happened just before the come-off?
questions.answer: At 0:40 there is a head contact marked watch. The come-off is the later check at 1:15.
